title: An embedded C¹ m-submanifold of ℝ^P is Borel and countably m-rectifiable (Simon 3.1.2, "if" part)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let N ⊆ ℝ^P be an embedded m-dimensional C¹ submanifold in the sense of the contract (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N): every y ∈ N has an open V ⊆ ℝ^m, an open W ⊆ ℝ^P with y ∈ W and a map ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P that is C¹ on V and injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ N, V ∩ ψ⁻¹(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) injective for every z ∈ V. Then N is a Borel set (MeasurableSet N) and N is countably m-rectifiable (CountablyRectifiable m N, the SimonGMT form of Simon Ch. 3, 1.1).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (N : Set (Euclid P)), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m N → MeasurableSet N ∧ CountablyRectifiable m N
